lines.speaker: Trang (project lead)
lines.text: Hung, how's the release going? We have a really tight deadline this time.

lines.speaker: Hung
lines.text: I know. Actually, we're ahead of schedule so far, which is a relief.

lines.speaker: Trang (project lead)
lines.text: That's great news. But it's crunch time now, so let's stay focused.

lines.speaker: Hung
lines.text: Agreed. I had to pull an all-nighter yesterday to fix the last bug.

lines.speaker: Trang (project lead)
lines.text: Thank you for that. Can we push back the testing session by an hour?

lines.speaker: Hung
lines.text: Sure, but I have a hard stop at 5pm for a client call.

lines.speaker: Trang (project lead)
lines.text: No problem, we'll finish before then. We can't let this deadline slip again.

lines.speaker: Hung
lines.text: Right. Let's just hope the client doesn't change anything at the eleventh hour.

lines.speaker: Trang (project lead)
lines.text: Fingers crossed. I'll update the team on our progress now.

lines.speaker: Hung
lines.text: Sounds good. I'll send you the final build in ten minutes.
